theme.zh: 游戏道具制作与团队共享

followup.en:
The pilot would use 10 real props or characters from your team's project, with the same quality requirements you use today.

Your artists would record the time to the first useful model, generation and retry costs, then the cleanup and review needed for approval. Depending on the asset, checks can include topology, polygon count, UVs, materials, formats, rigging and the result in your game engine. They would also note whether a teammate can find and reuse the approved work without another handoff. Admins would track time spent managing credits and member access.

Include unsuccessful attempts in the total, then compare the cost per approved asset with your current process. This covers the work needed to get usable assets, not just a quick generation result.

Files refined outside Tripo remain in your team's production workflow. Your team keeps the approval records and any required disclosures under its own policies.

Leave your details to plan the 10-asset pilot. The scope, access, fees and division of work will be agreed before it starts.
followup.zh:
试点围绕您团队项目里的 10 个真实道具或角色开展，质量要求仍按团队现有标准。

美术会记录拿到首个可用模型的时间、生成与重试费用，以及做到验收通过所需的清理修改和审核。按资产的实际用途，检查拓扑、面数、UV、材质、格式、需要时的绑定，以及游戏引擎内的效果。也看看另一位成员能不能找到并复用已审核成果，少一次交接；管理员则记录积分和权限管理花了多少时间。

没有通过的尝试也计入总成本，再与现有流程比较：最终每个通过验收的资产，实际花了多少钱、多少工时。不只看生成一个模型有多快。

在 Tripo 外精修的文件，仍由团队在自己的制作流程里管理。审核记录和必要披露，也按照团队自身规范保留。

留下联系方式，规划 10 个资产的团队试点。开始前会确认具体内容、使用权限、费用和双方分工。

subject.en: 3D props for your next game update
subject.zh: 下一版游戏的 3D 道具

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team making new props for the next game update? With Tripo, your artists can generate starting models from reference images, then refine them for the game. Your team can try this on a few planned props to see whether it saves time overall.

Tripo Studio Team Plan brings generated assets, shared credits and member access into one workspace. Your artists can find and reuse shared models instead of making the same starting point again or waiting for another file handoff. Admins can manage people and usage in one place rather than across separate accounts.

If you'd like to try it, leave your details to plan a pilot using 10 props or characters from your project. The comparison includes edits and review, so your team can compare the full cost of approved assets with its current process.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队正在为下一版游戏制作新道具吗？美术可以用 Tripo 从参考图生成初版模型，再继续修改到符合游戏要求。可以先拿计划中的几个道具试试，看看连同后续修改，整体能不能少花些时间。

Tripo Studio Team Plan 把生成资产、共享积分和成员权限放进同一个工作区。美术可以找到并复用共享模型，少做一遍相同的初版模型，也少等一次文件交接。管理员能统一管理成员和用量，不必分别处理多个账号。

如果想让团队试试，留下联系方式，与 Tripo 规划一次基于项目里 10 个道具或角色的试点。修改和审核也会算进去，方便团队与现有流程比较最终通过验收的资产总成本。

theme.en: 3D generation in your team's game tools
theme.zh: 在团队现有游戏工具里接入 3D 生成

followup.en:
Your engineers connect the API to your asset tool: submit text or images, check task status and retrieve the model if generation succeeds. Artists then refine it in their usual tools. A completed generation task is not project approval.

The proposed test uses the same 10 real asset briefs or reference images to compare API generation with your current workflow. Your team sets the acceptance checks: topology, polygon count, UVs, rigging, file formats and behavior in the target engine, as relevant to each asset.

Alongside the time to the first approved model, the comparison records generation and retry fees, artist cleanup and review time, plus integration and maintenance work. The total includes rejected attempts and rework, rather than counting only successful generations.

Your team keeps generation and review records, and handles any required disclosures in its own process. Leave your details to plan the test; scope, access, costs and responsibilities will be agreed before work begins.
followup.zh:
您的工程团队把 API 接入资产工具：提交文字或图片、查询任务状态，在生成成功后取回模型。美术再用熟悉的软件继续修改。生成任务完成，不代表模型已通过项目验收。

计划用项目里的 10 个真实资产需求或参考图，与当前制作流程做对比。您的团队按资产用途确定验收项，包括拓扑、面数、UV、绑定、文件格式和目标引擎中的表现。

除首个模型通过验收的耗时外，也记录生成与重试费用、美术清理和审核工时，以及接入和维护工作。总投入包含失败尝试和返工，而不是只统计成功生成的次数。

生成与审核记录及必要的披露，由您的团队按自身规范处理。留下联系方式，规划这次测试；开始前会确认范围、使用权限、费用和分工。

subject.en: Generate models from references in your own tools
subject.zh: 在自己的工具里，从参考图生成模型

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team adding a way for artists to upload a reference image and generate a starting model inside your asset tool?

Tripo API adds text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation to your existing tools, without your team building and maintaining the generation model. Your engineers handle the integration. Artists refine the results in their usual software, while your team keeps control of the interface, project standards and final approval.

Your team can compare 10 real project assets with its current workflow, including integration work, generation and retry fees, and artist cleanup. The comparison covers what it takes to reach an approved model, not just a generated one.

Leave your details to discuss a 10-asset API test plan for your team.
intro.zh:
%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

您的团队是否正在给资产工具加入一项功能，让美术上传参考图，就能在工具里生成初版模型？

Tripo API 可以把文生 3D 和图生 3D 接入现有工具，团队不必自建和维护底层生成模型。工程团队负责接入，美术用熟悉的软件继续修改；工具界面、项目标准和最终验收仍由您的团队掌握。

团队可以拿项目里的 10 个真实资产，与现有流程做一次对比，把接入工作、生成与重试费用和美术清理都计入。比较的是模型达到验收要求的总投入，而不只是生成一个模型。

留下联系方式，沟通适合您团队的 10 个资产 API 测试计划。

%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

团队在做新关卡原型时，能否让美术直接在自己的工具里，输入简短描述，生成道具的初版模型？

Tripo API 可以把文生 3D 和图生 3D 接入现有工具，团队不必自建和维护底层生成模型。工程团队负责接入，美术用熟悉的软件继续修改；工具界面、项目标准和最终验收仍由您的团队掌握。

团队可以拿项目里的 10 个真实资产，与现有流程做一次对比，把接入工作、生成与重试费用和美术清理都计入。比较的是模型达到验收要求的总投入，而不只是生成一个模型。

留下联系方式，沟通适合您团队的 10 个资产 API 测试计划。

footer.en: Tripo provides generation. Your team handles integration, refinement and final approval.
footer.zh: Tripo 提供生成能力；您的团队负责接入、修改和最终验收。

theme.en: 3D product content for your pages and platform
theme.zh: 为产品页面和内容平台制作 3D 展示

followup.en:
Your engineers connect the API to your platform: submit product images, check task status and retrieve the models if generation succeeds. Your content team checks them against the products and makes corrections. Your team handles the viewer and approves publication.

The proposed test uses images from 10 real products to compare API generation with your current workflow. Checks cover product accuracy and, where relevant, topology, polygon count, UVs, file formats and performance in your page viewer.

The comparison records time to the first approved model, generation and retry fees, manual cleanup and review, plus integration and maintenance work. The total includes rejected attempts and rework, rather than treating a generated model as a finished product asset.

Your team keeps generation and review records, and handles any required disclosures in its own process. Leave your details to plan the test; scope, access, fees and responsibilities will be agreed before work begins.
followup.zh:
您的工程团队把 API 接入平台：提交产品图片、查询任务状态，在生成成功后取回模型。内容团队对照真实产品检查和修正，由您的团队负责查看器和发布验收。

计划用 10 款真实产品的图片，对比 API 生成与当前制作流程。验收检查产品还原情况，并按用途核对拓扑、面数、UV、文件格式及页面查看器中的表现。

评测记录首个模型通过验收的耗时、生成与重试费用、人工清理和审核，以及接入和维护工作。总投入包含失败尝试和返工，不把刚生成的模型直接当作已完成的产品资产。

生成与审核记录及必要的披露，由您的团队按自身规范处理。留下联系方式，规划这次测试；开始前会确认范围、使用权限、费用和分工。

subject.en: Adding a 3D view to your product pages?
subject.zh: 准备给产品页面加上 3D 展示吗？

intro.en:
Hi %FIRSTNAME%,

Is your team adding a 3D view to its product pages, so customers can turn a product around and see it from different angles?

Tripo API adds image-to-3D generation to your content platform without your engineers building and maintaining the generation model. Your content team checks and refines the outputs against the actual products. Your engineers connect the models to your chosen viewer; your team controls the customer experience, review and publishing.

A 10-asset API test can use images of real products to compare your current workflow with API generation, through to models approved for your pages. Your team can include integration, model corrections and review in the time and cost comparison.

Leave your details to discuss a 10-asset API test plan for your platform.

%FIRSTNAME%，您好，

Tripo API 可以为内容平台接入图生 3D，工程团队不必自建和维护生成模型。内容团队对照真实产品检查和修改结果，工程团队将模型接入您选用的查看器；客户体验、审核和发布仍由您的团队掌握。

一次 10 个资产的 API 测试，可以用真实产品图片比较现有流程与 API 生成，从制作一直记录到模型通过页面展示要求的验收。接入、模型修正和审核，都计入工时和成本。
